Package chess.gui

Class GameController

java.lang.Object
chess.gui.GameController
All Implemented Interfaces:
GameListener
public final class GameController extends Object implements GameListener
Connects the Swing view to the game: the "controller" in Model-View-Controller.

It turns clicks into moves, asks the computer for its moves, and updates the panels when the game tells it something changed. All the chess rules stay in Game and ChessRules; this class only decides what to ask them and what to show.

    • computerTurnIfNeeded

      private void computerTurnIfNeeded()
      If it's the computer's turn, waits briefly and then makes its move.

      A Timer runs the action once after the delay, on Swing's event thread, so the player's own move is drawn before the computer starts thinking. Restart stops the timer so an old move can't be played in a new game.
